parsed.rationale: Both participating records in this cluster have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/ReviewRequestServiceTests.swift`. Although the two methods — `shouldRequestReviewAtThreshold` (line 90) and `actionsAfterReviewDoNotRetrigger` (line 177) — share a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.818), they test distinct behavioural scenarios of `ReviewRequestService`: one verifies the threshold trigger condition and the other verifies that a completed review suppresses re-triggering. Their structural resemblance is expected because both exercise the same system under test with similar arrange-act-assert scaffolding, not because of accidental duplication. Collapsing them would obscure the intent of each test case and reduce diagnostic clarity on failure.
